decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service moved from a mention to a dedicated page in 2024, which signals growing public commitment and fits the firm's announced direction of integrating geospatial IT with enterprise systems.

The open GIS application development framework reflects the firm's strategic emphasis on open, extensible components, and it represents sunk development effort, so management will likely persist even though it gets only a modest mention on the website.
The identity service was publicly announced as new, refined in its wording, and given its own page, so visibility and investment are high and the firm is strongly committed to it.
The consulting workshop launched only in 2024 with its own page and builds on the firm's core consulting capability, so any weak early results can still be attributed to the start-up phase.
